name: 19 (2026-11-25 mid-morning)
what: Track E: the G3 scope amended after its independent review, the floor test at 256 cells, the pilot; Track A: answers to the fresh verifier, the smoothed-edge test, the oblate test
note: Releases core-v0.4 to v0.7 are on main. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0037 to 0040. After git merge main: nrpic-run finish closes runs continued in place, and finish and verify keep a checksum cache (drop --no-checksums; one pass with --full before a gate review): the orchestrator's note of 2026-11-25 in your inbox. The cards are held by another partition for hours at a time: never wait for a run. The week's usage is tight (decision 0040 item 5): about an hour, read what the task needs. Every number with its run id; prediction before every test; figures made by registered scripts and looked at.

items.extra: Extra for this session (about ninety minutes, no card needed for most of it). (1) The independent review of the G3 scope is in g3/scope_review/SCOPE_REVIEW.md; ruling: coord/DECISIONS/0040 item 1. Check its three blocking findings from its artefacts (rerun its registered calculation for the bin defect of langevin/scripts/ref_spec.py lattice_factor_fn with your own numbers), then amend scope section 4d BEFORE any production run of G3, each amendment dated and the earlier wording kept: correct the reference and rerun its pilot with the variance gate the review proposes; judge variance and tail shape separately; replace the two tests of the zeta reader by tests that can fail at second order (its Z0 to Z2) and run them on processors; the state at N_f in the reference output; the baseline as mirrored pairs; a minimum number of judged dumps for the constraint criterion; the model test for the Richardson criterion; the target of the importance sampler at nu = 4; the number of seeds set together with the number of reference realisations (the reference's error dominates beyond about eighty seeds at nu = 3). The gauge leg with a lapse driven by K is withdrawn as a criterion (it coincides with the geodesic slice to one part in a million and cannot fail): state the limitation in the scope; a field-dependent lapse is a request to core for later (outbox), not for G3. Predictions for the amended criteria in the journal; commit the amended scope before the first production submission. (2) Queue entry q0038 FL256h has ended: read it with floor/floor_read.py (floor/JOURNAL.md entry 4), and replace the note's sentence that calls the floor open; registered rerun of the note only if a number in it changes. (3) The pilot q0045: read it if it has run. Then queue through the shared queue what the amended scope allows, several seeds per job, six new entries at most, priority 5 (2 for what the gate package waits for).

Extra for this session (about an hour). (1) The fresh verifier's report is stage/G2/VERIFIER-C18.md (package stage/G2/verifier-c18; rulings coord/DECISIONS/0040 items 2 and 3). Answer each finding with a registered analysis, not by rewording: read found or not found from horizon_status_0.txt (the summary repeats the last accepted surface after a failed search) and recheck every claim of the form 'found in all N searches' and every persistence time; the four mass medians the verifier does not reproduce (B-d0.42, B-d0.40, B-d0.35, C-d0.42) and A's median: state which exact mass each is compared with (the verifier recovers the claimed size only with the exact mass at the last trapped tracked particle), give the bracket of the exact mass that the tracked set allows, and correct the README where a number does not stand; state the interpolation used for the detection-time difference and its spread near the core edge; name the time measure of the threshold in the gate text. Criteria that failed stay failed. Then judge C18 in the checklist from the verifier's report. (2) The smoothed-edge test K4 (run A-20261125-120525-8fb946e) has ended or will soon: judge it against K4a to K4c with a registered analysis and a figure; ruling 0039 item 2(c) says how item C3 is judged afterwards. (3) Ruling 0039 item 2(a): decide whether the triaxial run already queued (q0015) serves as test A2 with the Zel'dovich time of first shell crossing as its reference, or queue one oblate member (six card-hours at most, prediction first, priority 2). (4) nrpic-stage collect, verify and report for G2; say item by item what G2 still lacks and which queue entry serves it.
